title: Destin Water Fun Pontoon & Watersports Rentals
specs: Dolphin sightings common on jet ski dolphin tours and sunset cruises
Double decker pontoons have upper deck and optional water slide
Operating zone includes Crab Island, Destin Harbor, and Choctawhatchee Bay grass flats
Minimum age 18 to operate pontoon boats and jet skis
Drivers born on or after Jan 1, 1988 must have Florida Boating Safety Education ID card or take temporary test at check-in
Jet ski riders minimum age 5; children cannot sit on front of ski; max 2 riders up to 400 lbs or 3 riders up to 350 lbs
Valid photo ID required for all drivers
Jet ski dolphin tours limited to 8 jet skis per guide
Sunset dolphin cruise vessel seats up to 27 passengers; also available as private charter
includes: Fuel included with all pontoon and jet ski rentals
USCG safety equipment including life jackets sized for kids and adults
Bluetooth stereo on pontoons (subject to availability)
Pre-departure safety video and on-water orientation for jet ski tours
Licensed guide leading jet ski dolphin tours
Complimentary iced bottled water on sunset dolphin cruise
gap: Exact weight limits for pontoon passengers not stated
blurb: Guests rent pontoon boats or jet skis to explore Destin Harbor and Choctawhatchee Bay, with options for guided dolphin tours or sunset cruises. Pontoon rentals include fuel, safety equipment, and have a 13-mile operating radius excluding the Gulf of Mexico. Jet ski dolphin tours are guided, about 90 minutes long, and suitable for riders aged 5 and up.
extraNote: $500 refundable deposit required for pontoon rentals or optional non-refundable damage protection ($75 or $25) · $25 cleaning fee for boats returned in poor condition · Late returns billed at $50 per 15 minutes · $500 penalty per equipment if pontoon boats go outside 13-mile radius or enter Gulf of Mexico · $3 NASBLA test available on site for temporary boater certificate
